conditions.execution: fresh target process per sample, helper startup excluded
conditions.cache: OS cache uncontrolled, explicit warm-up; NOT cold-cache
conditions.ordering: deterministically shuffled baseline/current/rg order for each paired repetition
conditions.correctness: matching-file count on every sample; full path/count checks separately in perf_benchmark.py
conditions.comparison: RS count-only; rg complete occurrence scans via --count-matches, not -l early exit
conditions.rss: process high-water; POSIX can include Python inherited pre-exec floor
conditions.build: excluded; baseline/current creation must be timed separately
